# Aider governance

Read ai-governance/GOVERNANCE-RULES.md once per task, unless already loaded and unchanged. Use available file and command tools only; if unavailable, request the needed material and report unverified checks. Match existing project conventions. Never claim tests or approvals you have not observed. Do not modify external systems merely because a workflow mentions them.

Attach this conventions file and the shared runtime using the tool's supported context mechanism; copying files alone does not confirm they loaded.
